evidence: Refactors wallet internals by extracting ~800 lines of legacy wallet migration logic from src/wallet/wallet.cpp into dedicated migration and utility files.
rationale: Extracts legacy wallet migration out of wallet.cpp to improve code organization and readability. While reducing the 4,500-line wallet.cpp file improves maintainability and 'paves the way for it being descriptor specific', it is primarily an internal move-only refactoring without an immediate bug fix or direct user-facing payoff.
